titleStmt.title: Richard Nixon and Joe Biden Tape Conversation Transcript

sourceDesc.p: This information comes from a transript of nixontapes.org

div.u: Hello, Mr. President, how are you?
Senator, I know this is a very tragic day for you, but I wanted you to know that all of us here at the White House were thinking about you, and praying for you and also for your two childen, and --
I understand you were on the Hill at the time, and your wife was just driving by herself.

In any event, looking at it as you must in terms of the future, because you have the great fortune of being young, I remember I was two years older than you when I went to the House. But the main point is you can remember that she was there when you won a great victory, and you enjoyed it together. And now, I'm sure that she'll be watching you from now on. Good luck to you.
Thank you very much, Mr. President. I appreciate your call. I appreciate it.
